Center stage left, a black cat sleeps atop a stack of leather-bound scripts, ignoring the bustle around it. The technician looks at the bulb intently, reaching out with a gloved hand. To their right, a large potted fern stands beside a metal coat rack draped with heavy wool coats. A young actor in a pirate costume leans against the coat rack, checking a pocket watch. Next to the pirate, a ballerina in pink tights stretches her leg against the wall, her face focused. In the center background, a director in a beret gestures wildly at a script held by an assistant in glasses. The assistant looks at the director, nodding slightly while clutching a clipboard. A brown dog lies on the floor near the assistant’s feet, chewing on a rope toy. On the far right, a makeup artist applies powder to the face of an elderly actress in a feathered hat. The actress sits on a folding chair, looking at her reflection in a vanity mirror. Beside them, a box of props containing plastic swords and fake jewels sits open on the floor. A child in a page boy outfit stands next to the prop box, peeking inside with curiosity. Above the child, a bundle of thick black cables hangs from the ceiling, looping down toward the floor. A security guard in a uniform stands near the exit door on the right, watching the scene with crossed arms. There is no sunlight streaming through windows.
